设计意图： Combines herding consensus (rank correlation of returns and volume changes over 20 days) with directional pressure (normalized dollar imbalance) via rank multiplication. The herding component captures agreement between price and volume direction; the pressure component adds the magnitude and sign of order flow. Multiplying their ranks amplifies signals when both are aligned and strong, enhancing n

因子路由 / 公式 ⚠ 已翻转（IC<0）⚠ FE DSL 暂不支持

-(rank_corr(ret, vol_chg, 20) * cs_rank(ema_imbalance / std_imbalance))
依赖列: open, high, low, close, volume

📐 因子表达式 DSL (FactorEngine)

-(rank_corr(ret, vol_chg, 20) * cs_rank(ema_imbalance / std_imbalance))
已转 FactorEngine（真实 DSL，parse_expr 验证通过）

🧮 计算步骤（DSL 算子链）

  1. 步骤1：rank_corr(ret, vol_chg, 20) → 滚动窗口秩相关系数
  2. 步骤2：divide(ema_imbalance, std_imbalance) → 除法：x ÷ y（分母为 0 时返回 0/NaN 保护）
  3. 步骤3：cs_rank(v2(divide)) → 截面排名（当日横截面上按值排序的百分位排名）
  4. 步骤4：multiply(v1(rank_corr), v3(cs_rank)) → 乘法：x × y
  5. 步骤5：neg(v4(multiply)) → 返回-x

🔬 陌生算子/字段释义

算子/字段含义
rank_corr滚动窗口秩相关系数

📝 计算步骤（一步一步解释）

  1. 计算 ret：close.pct_change()
  2. 计算 vol_chg：volume.pct_change()
  3. 计算 rank_ret：ret.rank()
  4. 计算 rank_vol：vol_chg.rank()
  5. 计算 rank_corr：rank_ret.滚动窗口(20).corr(rank_vol)
  6. 计算 imbalance：(close - open) * volume
  7. 计算 ema_imb：imbalance.ewm(span=5).mean()
  8. 计算 std_imb：imbalance.滚动窗口(20).std()
  9. 计算 dp：ema_imb / (std_imb + 1e-10)
  10. 计算 rank_dp：dp.rank()
  11. 计算 factor：rank_corr * rank_dp
⚠ 该因子原始 IC 为负，已整体取反（×(-1)）调正方向；下列步骤展示的是原始公式的计算过程。

🐍 原始 Python 代码 (factor_delivery)

"kw">class="kw">def factor_herding_pressure(df): df_copy = df.copy() ret = df_copy["str">'close'].pct_change() vol_chg = df_copy["str">'volume'].pct_change() rank_ret = ret.rank() rank_vol = vol_chg.rank() rank_corr = rank_ret.rolling(20).corr(rank_vol) imbalance = (df_copy["str">'close'] - df_copy["str">'open']) * df_copy["str">'volume'] ema_imb = imbalance.ewm(span=5).mean() std_imb = imbalance.rolling(20).std() dp = ema_imb / (std_imb + 1e-10) rank_dp = dp.rank() factor = rank_corr * rank_dp factor.name = "str">'factor_herding_pressure' "kw">class="kw">return factor
